description.value: Subcity Donair is a multi-location Okanagan chain specializing in beef and chicken donairs made with a proprietary blend of 23 herbs and spices, served with a choice of seven sauces. The downtown Kelowna location sits on Bernard Avenue, the city's main commercial street, making it a convenient mid-ride stop. A dedicated vegetarian menu featuring falafel and veggie subs broadens its appeal to cyclists with varied dietary needs.
